{{Recipe summary
| Category = Cake recipes
| Servings = 10
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

This is a popular and tasty [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]].

==Ingredients==
* 8 [[cookbook:coconut|coconut]]s 
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (120 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) of white granulated [[cookbook:sugar|sugar]] 
* 9 [[Cookbook:Egg yolk|egg yolk]]s 
* 3–4 [[Cookbook:Pound Cake|pound cake]]s (biscochuelo) cut in ½-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] [[Cookbook:Slicing|slices]]
* 1 bottle of [[cookbook:Wine|moscatel wine]]
* Powdered [[cookbook:cinnamon|cinnamon]]

== Procedure ==
# Grate the coconut meat. Separate the flesh from the milk of the coconut.
# Combine the coconut flesh with the sugar, reserving the milk. Cook until a thick [[Cookbook:Syrup|syrup]] is made. Remove from heat and to allow to rest. 
# Beat the yolks with a little bit of the coconut milk, then whisk this into the syrup. Mix well and return to the heat.
# Stir constantly until it thickens. The idea is to obtain a rather thick coconut [[Cookbook:Custard|custard]].
# Remove custard from the heat and let cool.
# Soak the cake pieces in wine.
# In a glass dish, layer the coconut custard and the cake slices. Continue alternating biscochuelo layers with the coconut custard.
# Sprinkle the top generously with cinnamon.
